newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian PM summons power ministers to meeting - RIA.
newsitem.headline: Russian PM summons power ministers to meeting - RIA.

text.p: Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin has summoned intelligence chiefs and Russia's defence and interior ministers to a special meeting on Thursday, RIA news agency said on Wednesday.

RIA said its sources had given no reason for the meeting. It was not clear whether Yeltsin's security chief Alexander Lebed would attend. Chernomyrdin is in charge of coordinating the work of the so-called "power ministries" as Yeltsin prepares for heart surgery.
RIA, which is quite close to the Kremlin, said the meeting would also be attended by Yeltsin's chief-of-staff Anatoly Chubais. Its report could not immediately be confirmed.
Interior Minister Anatoly Kulikov accused Lebed earlier on Wednesday of plotting to use force to seize power in Russia.
Lebed, a reserve paratroop general who joined Yeltsin's team after coming a strong third in the first round of this summer's presidential election, is at odds with many senior Kremlin officials.
